title: Eight Sleep rotating feature
description: A white two-column feature that cycles through four short claims: a mono eyebrow, the claims stacked in 44px type with the current one black and the rest pale grey, a small ring that fills while each claim is shown (6s), then that claim's subhead, a muted sentence and a full-width black button; a big rounded photo on the right crossfades with it. On phones the claims become a tab row with an underline and the photo sits under it.
notes: advances by itself every 6s (not under reduced motion); clicking a claim jumps to it
one media slot per claim, 640×640 r24 on desktop and 350×243 r16 on phones
